Whether you're buying your first business or selling the business that’s been your life’s work for thirty years, here's the deal: small business buying and selling (colloquially called M&A) is a complex maze to navigate, especially for the first time.

It’s emotional. It’s confusing. It’s full of people saying “on’t worry his is standard”—right before they ghost you, redline your deal to death, or casually drop a -page lease into your inbox labeled Final_Final_ActuallyFinalThisTime.pdf.

Meanwhile, you’ve got one foot on the boat, one foot on the dock, with no certainty as to whether or when the losing of the deal will happen and your life as you know it will change dramatically forever.

This book is your playbook. It won’t run the deal for you (nothing and no one but you should), but it is intended to give you the tactical background and practical toolkit you need to know what matters to you. Whether you’re the one writing the check or the one finally handing over the keys, you’re the expert in your business.

Inside, we’ll cover what really matters in a small business deal: not the terms and timelines, but the personalities, potholes, and panic moments that make or break transactions. You’ll learn how to spot bad advice, manage deal fatigue, and push through the uncomfortable conversations most people avoid.

If you want your deal to close—and not just close, but hold up after the champagne’s gone flat—this book is your manual. Let’s get into it.
